messages:
maya: scanner flagged an issue in the OSS HSM agent: CVE-2026-9999 (path traversal -> potential RCE). link: https://vuln.example/CVE-2026-9999. opening thread for triage.
jon: ack. immediate: cordon proxy nodes, revoke sessions, set SIEM to debug for proxy namespace, create incident channel. @oncall please run checklist.
kms-bot: Automated vuln scan created ticket INC-2026-900 (severity: high). recommended: isolate, patch, rotate session keys.
oncall: acknowledged. moving to incident. checklist posted in #incident/byok-900: 1) cordon proxies 2) revoke active operator sessions 3) increase audit verbosity 4) notify legal.
sasha: audit requirements: log wrap/unwrap events with operator identity and role, proxy instance id, agent binary hash, firmware id, key alias, rewrap chain id, and outcome. retention: SOC2 min 12 months, some contracts longer.
jon: SIEM payload should be compact. example fields: event, outcome, operator, operator_role, proxy_id, agent_hash, key_alias, rewrap_id, ts. keep audit export per-tenant index.
kevin: rotation question: if we rotate KEKs, we need a cross-wrap fallback to avoid breaking pinned model artifacts. ops should create a fallback KEK and document mappings.
sarah-legal: legal: if keys are customer-managed we need contract allowance for emergency rewrap. otherwise require customer consent. GDPR note: document legal basis for any non-consensual operations.
oncall: status update: proxies cordoned, sessions revoked, SIEM ingest toggled to debug, dry-run rewrap scheduled on two staging tenants (ETA 45m).
maya: assign owners: rewrap plan -> @kevin, SIEM schema -> @sasha, legal notif -> @sarah-legal, incident orchestration -> @oncall. collect SOC2 evidence pack after. keep discussion in #incident/byok-900.
